describe: A look: a material style plus a filter chain (post-processing), as data, with a unit test that it parses, posterizes with 0 or 8 and more levels, and that node x set post.look switches to it (PLAN.md WP 7.4).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/looks/<name> (its id is look:<name>; kebab-case, as the engine's looks are): labs/box/looks/ink-wash
next: make it look as its file comment says; import {{id}}.ts where the page loads its looks (the box: labs/box/main.ts); see it with node x shot labs/box --set post.look=look:{{name}}, or node x set post.look look:{{name}} in an inspect session; then node x docs --write
